summary: Texas Senate - Business & Commerce: 765-kV lines and grid reliability
location: Room E1.012 (Hearing Room), Texas Capitol Extension, 1100 Congress Ave., Austin, TX 78701
description:
Senate Committee on Business & Commerce, chaired by Sen. Charles Schwertner. Invited and public testimony on two interim charges:

Managing the Impacts of 765-kV Transmission Lines on Private Property Rights - reviewing the proposed route plans and their effect on homes, businesses and communities; whether current regulatory processes and timelines adequately protect landowner rights; and recommendations for transmission planning, permitting and siting.

Assessing the State of the Texas Electric Grid - SB 6 rulemaking including large load interconnection and transmission cost allocation, ERCOT load forecast confidence, the Texas Energy Fund and post-Uri reforms, and whether the ERCOT market remains competitive.

Public testimony is limited to 2 minutes per witness. Written testimony needs 15 copies to the committee clerk plus a digital copy by email. Registration closes at 11am on the day of the hearing.

Notice was marked REVISION - check the link for any later change.

description:
Senate Committee on Business & Commerce, chaired by Sen. Charles
Schwertner. Invited and public testimony on two interim charges:

Managing the Impacts of 765-kV Transmission Lines on Private Property
Rights - reviewing the proposed route plans and their effect on homes,
businesses and communities; whether current regulatory processes and
timelines adequately protect landowner rights; and recommendations for
transmission planning, permitting and siting.

Assessing the State of the Texas Electric Grid - SB 6 rulemaking
including large load interconnection and transmission cost allocation,
ERCOT load forecast confidence, the Texas Energy Fund and post-Uri
reforms, and whether the ERCOT market remains competitive.

Public testimony is limited to 2 minutes per witness. Written testimony
needs 15 copies to the committee clerk plus a digital copy by email.
Registration closes at 11am on the day of the hearing.

Notice was marked REVISION - check the link for any later change.
